modalLead: Filing several bookmarks in one sitting no longer means reopening the form each time. The add-bookmark modal gains a Create + New button that saves the bookmark and keeps the form open for the next one.

items.text: Create + New — save and keep going — a second button beside Create, in its own accent colour, saves the bookmark and leaves the modal open with a cleared form so the next one can be typed straight away. The page and category stay selected, because filing several bookmarks into the same place is the common case, and the caret lands back in the URL field ready for the next entry. The plain Create button is unchanged: it saves and closes as before.
